edits.headline: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the Nobel Prize in Literature
edits.subheadline: The Swedish Academy announced the 2026 prize on 8 October, the Nobel Prize organisation said.
editorialBody: Canadian poet Anne Carson won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature, the Swedish Academy announced on 8 October, blue News reported.
Bally Bagayoko, mayor of Saint-Denis, was caught in a viral video clash with police at a student march in Paris and said the protesters "could be my children", Reuters reported.
